title: Arsenal's Champions League scorers
brief: Name the ten players with the most Champions League goals for Arsenal since 1992/93.
period: Champions League seasons 1992/93 to 2025/26, group or league stage onwards

notes.Emmanuel Adebayor: Emmanuel Adebayor is just outside with 8.
notes.Nicklas Bendtner: Nicklas Bendtner is just outside with 8.
notes.Aaron Ramsey: Aaron Ramsey is just outside with 8.
notes.Lukas Podolski: Lukas Podolski is just outside with 8.

checks: Each player total is the sum of his goals for the club in every season, from UEFA.com season stats and from Transfermarkt season scorer lists; the two agree on every figure shown unless the value gives both. UEFA.com files a mid-season mover's whole season under his later club, so those seasons were split using Transfermarkt game logs.
